question: How many days of annual leave do I get per year?
reference_answer: Full-time employees get 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued at 1.5 days per completed month of service.

question: How many unused annual leave days can I carry forward to next year?
reference_answer: Up to a maximum of 10 days can be carried forward. Leave beyond the cap is forfeited unless HR grants special approval.

question: How many sick leave days do I get?
reference_answer: Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per year.

question: Do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
reference_answer: A medical certificate is required only for sick leave exceeding 2 consecutive days.

question: How long is maternity leave?
reference_answer: Female employees are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave.

question: How many days of paternity leave do male employees get and when must they use it?
reference_answer: Male employees get 10 days of paid paternity leave, to be availed within 3 months of the child's birth.

question: Can I take unpaid leave if I have used up all my paid leave?
reference_answer: Yes, with manager and HR approval, for a maximum of 15 days per year.

question: Who is eligible to work remotely?
reference_answer: Employees who have completed the 3-month probation period can work remotely up to 2 days per week, subject to manager approval based on role requirements.

question: What are the core working hours?
reference_answer: All employees, remote or in-office, must be available from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM IST.

question: How much is the home office setup allowance?
reference_answer: A one-time home office setup allowance of Rs. 15,000 for employees approved for remote work exceeding 3 days per week.

question: What is the maximum hotel cost per night I can claim on a business trip?
reference_answer: Standard hotel accommodation up to Rs. 6,000 per night can be claimed.

question: Can I claim traffic fines as an expense?
reference_answer: No. Traffic fines are not reimbursable under any circumstance.

question: How much is the health insurance cover and who is covered?
reference_answer: Group health insurance of Rs. 5,00,000 per year covering the employee, spouse and up to 2 dependent children, with no waiting period for pre-existing conditions.

question: What is the annual wellness allowance and what can it be used for?
reference_answer: An annual wellness allowance of Rs. 8,000, reimbursable against gym memberships, fitness classes or mental health counseling sessions.

question: How much can I claim each year for courses and certifications?
reference_answer: Up to Rs. 20,000 per year toward professional certifications, courses or conferences, subject to manager approval and relevance to the role.

question: What is the notice period when I resign?
reference_answer: The standard notice period is 60 days for full-time employees. The company may at its discretion approve a reduced notice period or a buyout of the remaining notice.

question: Can I work from home on Fridays?
reference_answer: After completing the 3-month probation, employees can work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval. The handbook does not name specific days.

question: What happens to my leftover leave if I quit?
reference_answer: Unused annual leave (up to the carried-forward cap) is encashed at resignation based on the last drawn basic salary. Sick leave is never encashed.

question: I want to report a problem with my manager without giving my name. How can I do that?
reference_answer: Use the anonymous ethics hotline available on the company intranet. Grievances can also go to the HR business partner.

question: Can I do freelance work on the side?
reference_answer: Outside employment or business interests that may conflict with the role must be disclosed to HR before accepting or continuing them.

question: What company items do I have to give back when I leave?
reference_answer: Company laptops, software licenses and access credentials must be returned in good condition upon separation.

question: Can I get reimbursed for a first-class flight ticket?
reference_answer: No. Only economy-class airfare is claimable, and first-class travel upgrades are not reimbursable under any circumstance.

question: I am not satisfied with how HR resolved my complaint. What can I do next?
reference_answer: Escalate the matter to the Head of HR, whose decision in consultation with leadership is final.

question: Is there any policy on pet-friendly benefits in this company?
reference_answer: Not covered in the handbook.

reference_answer: Not covered in the handbook.

reference_answer: Not covered in the handbook.

reference_answer: Not covered in the handbook.

reference_answer: Not covered in the handbook.

reference_answer: Not covered in the handbook.

reference_answer: Not covered in the handbook.

question: My wife just had a baby. How many days off can I take?
reference_answer: Male employees are entitled to 10 days of paid paternity leave, to be availed within 3 months of the child's birth.

question: Do I still get paid if I am out sick for a whole week?
reference_answer: Employees get 12 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for sick leave exceeding 2 consecutive days.

question: Does my medical coverage extend to my partner and kids?
reference_answer: Group health insurance of Rs. 5,00,000 per year covers the employee, spouse and up to 2 dependent children, with no waiting period for pre-existing conditions.

question: Will the company chip in for my gym membership?
reference_answer: An annual wellness allowance of Rs. 8,000 is reimbursable against gym memberships, fitness classes or mental health counseling sessions.

question: Can I stay home most of the week instead of coming to the office?
reference_answer: After the 3-month probation, employees can work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Full-time remote arrangements may be granted case by case for roles approved by department heads and are reviewed every 6 months.

question: How long do I have to turn in my bills after a business trip?
reference_answer: Claims must be submitted within 15 days of travel completion, with original receipts.

question: A coworker keeps making inappropriate comments about me. What should I do and what happens to them?
reference_answer: Harassment, discrimination or retaliation is not tolerated and may result in termination. The employee can raise a grievance through their reporting manager, an HR business partner, or the anonymous ethics hotline on the intranet.

question: Can I tell my friends about the clients I work with?
reference_answer: No. Employees must not disclose confidential company information, client data or trade secrets to any external party, during and after employment, as outlined in the signed NDA.

question: When will I get my last paycheck after I leave?
reference_answer: Final settlement, including salary dues, leave encashment and reimbursement claims, is processed within 45 days of the last working day.

question: Do I have to sit down with HR before my last day?
reference_answer: Yes. All departing employees are required to complete an exit interview with HR before their last working day.

question: Is it possible to leave sooner than the notice period?
reference_answer: The standard notice period is 60 days, but the company may at its discretion approve a reduced notice period or a buyout of the remaining notice.

question: How quickly will HR get back to me after I file a complaint?
reference_answer: HR acknowledges a formal grievance within 2 working days and aims to resolve it within 15 working days, with written communication at each stage.
